claims.statement: Tom Allen was under arrest at the Four Courts, St. Louis, charged with murder.

claims.statement: Tom Allen shot Tom Coupry in the course of a fracas in Allen's saloon in St. Louis.

claims.statement: Tom Coupry died at the city hospital shortly before midnight on the night of the shooting.

claims.statement: Allen said he thought Coupry was going to shoot him, and for that reason used his revolver.
